user.title: Set up Alfie
user.description: Alfie is a lively face for your home. You can rename him. Once he is added, open **Alfie** in the sidebar: Get started walks you through the rest.

abort.already_configured: Alfie is already set up. There is one Alfie per home.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Alfie is already set up. There is one Alfie per home.

init.title: Alfie
init.description: Everything about Alfie is set in the **Alfie** panel in the sidebar (admins only): what he watches, his mood, reactions, house modes, screens and appearance. There is nothing to set here.

set_expression.name: Set expression
set_expression.description: Make Alfie wear an expression, for a while or until set back to auto.

expression.name: Expression
expression.description: One of his expressions, or auto to follow his mood.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to hold it. Empty or 0 holds it until changed.

play_animation.name: Play animation
play_animation.description: Make Alfie do something once, on every display.

show_screen.name: Show screen
show_screen.description: Make every Alfie card present one of your screens for a while, then go back to what it was doing.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The ID of a screen from the Alfie panel (Screens).

play_story.name: Play story
play_story.description: Make Alfie play one of his stories on every display.

story.name: Story
story.description: The ID of a story from the Alfie panel (Reactions → Stories).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 0 to 100. Higher wins: it interrupts a story that is playing, otherwise it waits its turn.

busy.name: If a story is already playing
busy.description: auto (by priority), queue (wait its turn), interrupt, or skip.

stop_story.name: Stop story
stop_story.description: End the story Alfie is playing and drop any waiting ones.

show_icon.name: Show icon
show_icon.description: Make Alfie show any Home Assistant icon on every display: he turns into it, it shows beside him, or it goes on the card as a badge.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Any icon Home Assistant can show, like mdi:white-balance-sunny.

style.name: Style
style.description: Transform: he turns into it. Beside: he goes to his corner and it fills the rest. Badge: it goes on the card while he carries on.

transform.name: Turn into it
transform.description: Transform only. Whole: his ring and eyes become the icon. Ring only: his ring becomes it and his eyes stay.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Beside and badge: how it comes and goes (fade, zoom, draw, … or random). Empty: the card's for beside, zoom for a badge.

corner.name: Corner
corner.description: Beside only: which corner he goes to. Card: the card's own.

x.name: X
x.description: Badge at a custom place: -1 is the left edge, 1 the right.

y.name: Y
y.description: Badge at a custom place: -1 is the bottom edge, 1 the top.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Draw it in the ring's colour, the eyes' or the text's.

fill.name: Fill
fill.description: Outline only, a soft fill, or solid.

clear_icons.name: Clear icons
clear_icons.description: Take every icon off the displays.

set_mood.name: Set mood
set_mood.description: Hold Alfie's mood at a level for a while, over what his signals and the house mode say. Auto lets go.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to hold it, then it lets go. 0 or empty: until changed.

set_alfie.name: Set Alfie awake or asleep
set_alfie.description: Hold Alfie awake, asleep, quiet or hidden for a while, as a house mode's "Alfie is" does. Auto lets go.

state.name: Alfie is
state.description: awake, asleep, quiet, hidden, or auto.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to hold it, then it lets go. 0 or empty: until changed.

show_rotation.name: Show rotation
show_rotation.description: Switch every rotation card that follows house modes to a rotation, or pause it. Auto gives the cards back their own.

rotation.name: Rotation
rotation.description: A rotation from the Alfie panel, pause, or auto.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to show it, then it lets go. 0 or empty: until changed.

set_personality.name: Set personality
set_personality.description: Swap Alfie's personality preset for a while. Auto lets go.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to keep it, then it lets go. 0 or empty: until changed.

set_mode.name: Set house mode
set_mode.description: Pick a house mode, like select.alfie_mode, optionally for a while: afterwards it goes back to what was picked before.

mode.name: House mode
mode.description: A house mode, normal (none), or auto (follow the conditions).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds in the mode, then it lets go. 0 or empty: until changed.

set_enabled.name: Turn a signal or trigger on or off
set_enabled.description: Turns one of Alfie's signals or triggers on or off, saved, as its switch in the panel does.
